subject: Band transfer concierge + evidence request
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Band transfer concierge + evidence request

Team —

Quick summary: Orion Health has asked to move two ICs from Band 3 to Band 4 as part of a restructure that closes on Aug 21. People managers submitted appeals last week; we ran them through the calibration panel this morning. The panel is leaning toward approving one transfer (R. Singh) and holding the second (A. Patel) pending a stronger evidence packet.

Action I need from Laura and Olga: can we assemble a concise concierge packet for A. Patel that covers the following by EOD Monday (Aug 17)?
- 3 manager examples (date + impact) showing cross-team outcomes where A. Patel led ambiguous scope
- Peer feedback excerpts (anonymized) highlighting leadership stretch vs. contributor-level work
- Any project metrics where A. Patel materially changed roadmap or delivery cadence (Jira ticket refs ok)
- One short anchor-case writeup comparing A. Patel to a typical Band 4 profile we calibrated last quarter

I've attached the calibration notes and a starter folder with the template (transfer_evidence_pack.zip). Keep the packet concise — HR prefers one PDF plus a small appendix. Marissa, flagged you in case the panel wants to push an exception route if packet is still borderline.

If we can't make Mon EOD, suggest a fallback date (Aug 19) and we'll request a one-week pause from Orion while they collect materials.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Product Platforms
Redwood Inference

Attachments: transfer_evidence_pack.zip (zip), calibration_notes_2026-08-14.xlsx (xlsx)

Karthik —

Got it. We'll split the work: I'll pull the Jira/metrics and the anchor-case comparison; Olga will curate manager examples and peer excerpts. Quick notes:
- I can assemble the metrics snapshot (sprint burn, number of cross-team PRs, four key Jira tickets) today; it will be raw CSVs but we can summarize in one slide.
- Olga, do you have permission to include the peer quotes as-is, or should we redact names? HR usually wants anonymized quotes.

If we hit any gaps, I'll call out specifically so we can escalate to the manager for clarifying examples. Targeting a draft by Mon 11:00 so we have time for Marissa and Karthik to review before sending to Orion.

Laura Bennett
Senior People Partner
Redwood Inference

Thanks — quick calibration note from the panel that may help frame the packet: the panel agreed R. Singh's examples showed repeatable cross-functional influence and a clear ownership boundary shift; that was the clean approval. For A. Patel the work was high-quality but largely tactical across multiple projects rather than driving scope or org outcomes.

Two asks from my side before we finalize the packet:
1) If Laura can surface one concrete instance where A. Patel negotiated scope with a product partner (email thread or Jira comment is fine), it helps show boundary-pushing vs. execution.
2) We should include a short manager assessment (1-paragraph) that explicitly states why they believe the profile meets Band 4 expectations and what development steps remain — calibration panels trust an explicit manager judgment.

If after the packet the panel still deems it borderline, I'm comfortable recommending a timed trial (3 months) with clear success metrics as a middle path. That keeps Orion's program moving while giving the individual a path to fully migrate bands without a hard denial.

Marissa Cole
VP, People Operations
Redwood Inference

Perfect — appreciate the quick turnaround. A couple of logistical items before we wrap:
- Laura: when you share the draft folder, please include an index (one-pager) that lists what evidence is present and what is redacted. That helps HR and Orion scan faster.
- Olga: anonymize peer quotes and mark timestamps. If there are witness managers who can corroborate a negotiation instance, note them (we won't include private contact info in the packet).
- Marissa: I'll draft the timed-trial language and success metrics template (3 checkpoints over 90 days) and share a version for your sign-off by Mon morning.

Once we have the packet, I'll send it to Sasha at Orion (cc HR) with a note proposing either transfer approval or the timed-trial option. If Orion wants immediate resolution, we can escalate to the exec sponsor, but let's try the trial first.

I'll keep everyone looped. Thanks again.

Karthik
Director, Product Platforms
Redwood Inference
